title: Leadership Lesson 1: So Goes the Culture, So Goes the Company
coreMove: Read culture from repeated pressure behaviors, then change the signal people are copying.
sourcePressure: Makes culture causal: the company becomes what people learn to repeat under pressure from signals, rewards, tolerated tradeoffs, and protected behavior.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing culture to morale, values statements, or atmosphere instead of a repeated learning system.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.audience: owner noticing how returns are handled
exampleSpecs.stakes: culture teaches whether hiding defects is smarter than candor
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he refunds a faulty deck lantern publicly and thanks the clerk who flagged the batch
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a boxed deck lantern beside a refund slip

exampleSpecs.stakes: dancers copy whether pain is hidden or surfaced

exampleSpecs.audience: co-op manager after a moisture dispute
exampleSpecs.stakes: tolerated shortcuts teach the whole co-op what counts

exampleSpecs.firstImage: a grain sample cup beside a scale ticket

exampleSpecs.stakes: deadline culture teaches what errors are acceptable
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the producer traces the viral episode to the skipped source sheet before celebrating downloads

exampleSpecs.stakes: kids learn culture from what adults tolerate
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the director redraws lane assignments after seeing the coach's daughter moved twice
